emails.label: FAQ — Is this actually safe for me? (new)
emails.subject_new: Is this actually safe for me?

paragraphs.new: Every stretch was developed and validated with physiotherapists and movement specialists, who mapped which stretches are safe and in what order. WeStretch uses what you tell it about what's bothering you to decide which of those stretches you get. If something's off-limits for you, it's left out.

emails.notes: New FAQ added to back up the physiotherapist-mapping claim introduced earlier in How It Works.

emails.subject_old: Do I have to do all 15 minutes at once?
emails.subject_new: Do I have to do all 15 minutes at once?

paragraphs.new: No. You can spread your stretching throughout the day. Do a few stretches when you have time and finish the rest later. What matters is making those 15 minutes part of your day.
